name: SubpixelSync
tagline: Eliminate OLED text fringing with per-monitor subpixel rendering profiles
problem: Windows ClearType assumes RGB stripe subpixels, but WOLED (WRGB) and QD-OLED (triangular) monitors produce visible chromatic aberration on text edges. No OS-level fix exists for per-display subpixel configuration.
solution: A lightweight Windows tray utility that detects each monitor's subpixel layout, applies custom gamma/sharpening per RGBW channel via DirectWrite interception, and persists per-display profiles. Works without admin rights, survives reboots, and includes test patterns for visual calibration.
features: Auto-detect monitor subpixel layout via EDID + community database
Per-monitor rendering profiles (WOLED WRGB, QD-OLED triangular, RGB stripe, BGR)
Real-time test pattern overlay (color fringes, line pairs, text samples)
System tray control with global hotkeys (Win+Alt+S to toggle)
CLI for CI/CD and multi-machine deployment (subpixelsync apply --profile coding)
Export/import JSON profiles for team sharing
Startup persistence via Task Scheduler (no UAC prompt)
Open-source core with paid pro features (multi-monitor, CLI, auto-update)
mvp_scope: Build a C# .NET 8 WinUI 3 tray app that enumerates displays, reads EDID for panel type, lets user pick from 4 presets (WOLED, QD-OLED, RGB, BGR), applies a per-monitor ICC-style gamma LUT via SetDeviceGammaRamp, and persists settings. Ship with a built-in test pattern window. Target 30-day build.
tech_stack: DirectWrite / Direct2D via SharpDX or Silk.NET

competitors.name: Windows ClearType Tuner
competitors.gap: Assumes RGB stripe only; no per-monitor control; no WRGB/triangular support

competitors.name: BetterClearType (GitHub)
competitors.gap: Unmaintained since 2018; no OLED presets; requires manual registry edits

competitors.name: DisplayCAL / ArgyllCMS
competitors.gap: Full color calibration suite; overkill for subpixel fringing; no per-subpixel gamma

competitors.name: macOS Font Smoothing
competitors.gap: Global only; no subpixel layout awareness; not on Windows

competitors.name: PowerToys (requested)
competitors.gap: Issue open since 2023; no implementation; would still need per-monitor EDID detection

landing_copy.headline: Sharp text on every OLED. No registry hacks.
landing_copy.subheadline: SubpixelSync detects your monitor's true subpixel layout and applies per-display rendering correction — so code, docs, and UI stay crisp on WOLED and QD-OLED.
bullets: Auto-detects WRGB, triangular, RGB, BGR layouts via EDID
Test patterns for visual calibration in seconds
Tray app + CLI + portable — no admin, no install
Open-source core, free for single monitor

whatsapp_bot.flow: User messages bot with monitor model (e.g., 'AW3423DWF'). Bot replies with preset name + one-click .reg file or winget install link. User runs file, restarts app, fringing gone.
commands: /test — sends test pattern image for phone review
whatsapp_bot.pricing: Free bot. Pro features (multi-monitor sync, team profile sharing) $5/mo via Stripe link in bot.

pricing_model: Freemium: Free forever for 1 monitor. Pro $19 one-time (unlimited monitors, CLI, auto-update, profile export). Team $49/yr (shared profile repo, SSO).
